Messages.Author: Alanmut
Messages.Body: Here is my question: first I play Tariq (Adv.), turn him into an Anarch, and then on the next turn I evolve him into the base version—which sect prevails? Would Tariq become Independent or Sabbat?

Messages.Author: meneran
Messages.Body: Since I assume that normally there would be a sect change (Tariq ADV is Sabbat -> Tariq Merged is Independent), why does making the starting sect Anarch instead of Sabbat prevent the change?

Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:
Interesting. So, the Merge process happens simultaneously with the check for differences.

It doesn't work by first checking for discrepancies between the versions, correcting them, and then applying the "Merged" modifier.
(In that scenario, Tariq would have switched to Sabbat—regardless of his current sect—and then become Independent.)

Instead, the "Merged" modifier is applied, and the Advanced+Merged version is compared to the Basic version. (And since the Basic version and the Advanced+Merged version have the same sect, the sect doesn't change regardless of his current sect)

This one is tricky to see.

Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:
Even more complicated.

If you control the advanced version and merge it with the basic one, the resulting vampire will be Sabbat.

If you control the basic version and merge it with the advance one, the resulting vampire will be independent.

Messages.Author: meneran
Messages.Body:
Just to be sure that I understand this correctly (sorry for asking basically the same question second time, I just feel that there is some kind of misunderstanding) :

ADV Tariq (Sabbat) merges -> resulting Tariq is Independent because of the card text ( = his sect changes)

ADV Tariq (Sabbat) changes sect (to Anarch), then merges -> resulting Tariq is Anarch, because of this ruling ( = his sect does not change)

Messages.Author: KoRneeshon
Messages.Body: The priority is merged text > advanced version text > basic version text, and at each of these "stages", sect / clan can also be changed.

>
> ADV Tariq (Sabbat) changes sect (to Anarch), then merges -> resulting Tariq is Anarch, because of this ruling ( = his sect does not change)

Sorry, I read the OP question the other way.

Let's sum it up here:

Tariq base (Independent) merges with Tariq adv: Tariq stays Independent (merged sect)
Tariq adv (Sabbat) merges with Tariq base: Tariq becomes Independent (merged sect)

If Tariq base changes sect before merging, he keeps his sect.
If Tariq adv changes sect before merging, he becomes Independent.

Messages.Author: KoRneeshon
Messages.Body:
"If Tariq base changes sect before merging, he keeps his sect."

So merging doesn't "overwrite" sect if even it happens *after* Tariq changed his sect?

Messages.Author: meneran
Messages.Body:
> KoRneeshon wrote:
> "If Tariq base changes sect before merging, he keeps his sect."
>
> So merging doesn't "overwrite" sect if even it happens *after* Tariq changed his sect?
>
To know if merging will cause sect to change, you just look at the starting card (not the vampire in play) and look at the sect of the merged 'card' (again, not the resulting vampire in play).
If those two sects are the same, then process of merging never changes sect, it just keeps the starting sect. If those two sects are different, then merging will reset sect to the "merged" version.

To rephrase what Ankha has said:

When you start with Tariq basic, merging will never change his sect.
When you start with Tariq ADV, merging will always try to change his sect to Independent.

Messages.Author: KoRneeshon
Messages.Body: Got it, I forgot that merging text is only on ADV version.
